hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with a 1.2% fee on buys and sells. Buy fees accumulate ETH in a burn pot for buyback-and-burn every 20 swaps; sell fees queue tokens for burning. Sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback. Exact-output swaps always revert. Only one liquidity addition is permitted per token. Additionally, afterSwap has an allowlist: once activated by any caller via superTokens(), sells are blocked for all addresses not pre-approved by the deployer.
